Chicago bid
Chicago, the host of the previous Democratic and Republican conventions, sought to host both conventions in 1956. The city's bid team believed that Chicago's advantageously central geographic location in the United States and its expansive facilities for hosting the conventions were major advantages that would allow its bids to prevail. Chicago pledged to raise $250,000 in funding for there staging of the Republican convention.
While Chicago failed to secure the Republican convention, it did receive the opportunity to host the Democratic convention.
